We manufacture industrial cleaning chemicals, and we use Tally for our financials. Our factory floor is a black box because of yield variance across multiple mixing stages. We mix the base chemical in one vat, let it cure, and then bottle it on a different line. We have no idea what our actual material yield is at each workstation, so our product costing is completely inaccurate. We need to track the exact material consumption and machine time at each step of the routing process.
